facts.text: Golden Lamb calls the first-floor Buckeye Room “handicapped accessible” and lists seating for up to 40. The room is not available at every seating time. Confirm the entrance and seating arrangement when reserving; the label does not establish a complete step-free route.
facts.quote: Our one and only first-floor private dining room is not available at all seating times. This room is a divided entity of our general dining area. Seating in this room can be arranged for as many as 40 guests and is handicapped accessible.

facts.text: The hotel’s guest rooms are on the second, third and fourth floors with no elevator. This is the accommodation page’s description of access to overnight rooms; it does not describe the first-floor dining entrance or establish a current tavern lift.
facts.quote: They are located on the second, third and fourth floors of the building with no elevator.

facts.text: For carryout, order online and collect at the main entrance at 27 S. Broadway, or call 513-932-5065 from the car for staff to bring the order out. The page does not identify a collection bay or describe vehicle access and waiting arrangements.
facts.quote: Visit our online ordering app to place your order. Pick your order up at our main entrance on 27 S. Broadway OR call (513) 932-5065 from your car and our dedicated staff will bring your order to your car.

facts.text: Regular restaurant hours are Monday–Saturday 11:30 a.m.–9 p.m. and Sunday noon–8 p.m. The 2026 schedule gives Thanksgiving hours of 11 a.m.–6:30 p.m. and Christmas Day closed. Confirm the date and dining area before travelling.
facts.quote: We are open every day for lunch or dinner: Monday - Saturday, 11:30 a.m. - 9:00 p.m. Sunday, 12 - 8 p.m. 2026 Special Hours: Easter: 11 a.m. - 6:00 p.m. Mother's Day: 12 - 8:00 p.m. Memorial Day: 11:30 a.m. - 7 p.m. July 4: 11:30 a.m. - 7 p.m. Labor Day: 11:30 a.m. - 7 p.m. Halloween: 11:30 a.m. - 4 p.m. Thanksgiving: 11 a.m. - 6:30 p.m. Christmas Eve: 12 p.m. - 7:30 p.m. Christmas Day: Closed

facts.text: The restaurant says it does not accept Apple Pay or tap-to-pay. Arrange another payment method before visiting or collecting an order.
facts.quote: The Golden Lamb does not accept Apple Pay or Tap to pay as form of payment.

facts.text: The restaurant prohibits outside food and drinks in its dining rooms, including cakes and drinks. The page does not state an exception for dietary or medical needs; discuss any required arrangement with the venue in advance.
facts.quote: Due to local regulations, outside food and beverages are not permitted in our dining rooms. This would include cakes or drinks.

facts.text: The FAQ asks guests to notify staff of allergies because menu ingredient lists are abbreviated. This is a notification request, not a guarantee that a dish avoids an allergen or cross-contact.
facts.quote: Please notify us of any allergies you may have, as the ingredients listed on our menus are abbreviated.

additionalSupport.quote: Improvements to include a lift for persons with disabilities. The lift will be accessible at both levels of the building. We are also planning improved handicap parking.
additionalSupport.scope: January 14, 2019 proposal only; no completion or current-operation claim
